تستأجري (form X)
# تَسْتَأْجِرِي (tastaʔjirī) /tas.taʔ.d͡ʒi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
# تُسْتَأْجَرِي (tustaʔjarī) /tus.taʔ.d͡ʒa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
